Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: Exam administration workspace containing school settings, committee, supervisors, tracks, exam schedule, supervisor matrix, and exam rules.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

school.description: School identity, exam metadata, logos, and preface configuration.

supervisors.description: List of exam room supervisors with codes (max 100).

examDays.description: List of exam days and sessions (max 30).

supervisorSchedule.description: Map of day__session keys to room->supervisorCode assignments.

proposal.description: Editable exam proposal document configuration and RAB budget table.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Individual exam participant record stored under a workspace subcollection.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

orderIndex.description: Ordering index for deterministic seating and list display.

photoDataUrl.description: Optional compressed data URL for student passport photo.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when student was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Primary per-user exam administration workspace document.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}/students/{stud.description: Exam participant records belonging to the parent workspace.
